name: testwright
description: Point Claude at any web app: it maps the routes, writes a QA test suite into an Excel workbook, and runs it in a real browser and with curl. Most cases execute with zero model tokens.

bugsheet_client_id.title: Bug sheet: Google OAuth client ID
bugsheet_client_id.description: Client ID of a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app, with the Google Sheets API enabled.

bugsheet_client_secret.title: Bug sheet: Google OAuth client secret
bugsheet_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same OAuth client. Stored in your system's secure credential store.
